title: 扩展人工验收Paper最小修复计划反向评审

basis.original_plan_md: md/扩展人工验收Paper最小修复计划.md
basis.original_plan_json: md/扩展人工验收Paper最小修复计划.json

author_storage.new_shape: JSON array of canonical bounded author names

legacy_shapes.object_with_authors_list: normalize and read as legacy_uncovered until verified resync
legacy_shapes.empty_or_malformed: empty authors and fail closed for author claims

conditions: authors parse to a nonempty bounded list
server recomputes the current-version content hash from the row's trusted fields
recomputed hash equals the stored content_hash
authors_hash_coverage.forbidden_shortcut: Never infer coverage from authors_json list shape alone.
authors_hash_coverage.hash_payload: The same full bounded canonical author list used by resource_content is included in content_hash.

author_summary_span.excerpt_format: Author information (excerpt, showing k of n): <whole names>
rules: never cut a name in the middle
reserve one of eight text spans for the author summary and at most seven for abstract/text
only current-hash-verified structured paper authors may create this semantic type
candidate author claim must equal the whole exact_text after approved normalization
server must not create, replace, extend or rebind model claims

paper_request_and_selection.completeness_scope: Only selected_paper_source_ids are checked and exposed to model/bindings/renderer/citations.
paper_request_and_selection.unselected_behavior: Filtered or unselected papers must not remain in answer evidence, verified bindings, final answer, or citation cards.
paper_request_and_selection.link_contract: Parse the selected paper Citation DTO source_url and require HTTPS plus host; verify it belongs to the same selected EvidenceItem/provenance identity and is consistent with external_id/content_hash. A boolean marker alone is insufficient.

query_and_relevance.normalization: Frozen versioned constants, longest phrase first, bounded bilingual stopwords and output-instruction stop phrases; no model-generated dictionary.
minimum_gate: exact DOI/arXiv/title locators only bypass scoring for the matching identity
if both domain/entity and security/task groups exist, candidate must match at least one concept in each
if only one meaningful group exists, candidate must match that group
generic 5G or stopword overlap alone is insufficient
query_and_relevance.required_negative_family: NOMA/spectral-efficiency and other broadly 5G but security-irrelevant papers

source_auto.internal_fallback: Semantic Scholar may fall back to arXiv only after connector failure, rate limit, transport failure, or existing explicit failure semantics.
source_auto.success_but_irrelevant: Filter to partial/no-relevant result; do not make a second Agent tool call or secretly force arXiv.

retry_and_guard.retry_feedback: Bounded server-owned error type and missing selected source/field enums in the actual provider messages; no model body, full abstract, secret, or internal object.
retry_and_guard.second_failure: ABSTAIN with the actual final error; never restore candidate 0, add candidate 2, or use Template as success.

allowed: per-selected-paper field and actual Citation URL validation
safe retry guidance in actual model messages

forbidden: timeouts, retry budgets, global tool budgets
frozen_file_whitelist.scope_stop: Stop with SCOPE_REVIEW_REQUIRED if implementation needs an eighth file, a fifth product file, or a fourth test file.

test_gates.automation_mode: Offline controlled fixtures only; no DeepSeek, live Connector, MCP process, FastAPI, Streamlit, or browser in 9J.
red_green_required: new authors array SQLite roundtrip; legacy wrapper compatibility; malformed safe empty
list shape with current-hash mismatch remains authors_hash_covered=false; verified resync and exact recompute match makes it true
author-only change changes resource_content and content_hash
long abstract preserves a <=300-character author summary span; excerpt marker and whole-name truncation are enforced
malicious/overlong author text cannot become instructions or spoof semantic type
only selected papers are exposed and each selected paper has title/author-summary/abstract fields when requested
actual same-paper Citation DTO HTTPS URL is validated; boolean-only or mismatched URL fails
three-paper full pass and honest one/two-paper partial passes
zero relevant, partial count, and field-unavailable terminals are deterministic and distinct
four Chinese-topic to English-paper positive fixtures and NOMA-like negative fixtures
source=auto has one Agent paper_search_real call and one MCP request; success-but-irrelevant does not trigger another Agent tool call
existing connector-failure to arXiv fallback remains compatible
one same-evidence generation retry only; second incomplete candidate abstains
wrong source/span, forged author, duplicate paper, no abstract, prompt injection, and untrusted/non-HTTPS provenance reject
compatibility: existing Citation Guard positive and negative cases
current-run paper/vulnerability/project multi-source coverage without historical PASS stitching
test_gates.full_pytest: Run once on final stable code with a fresh isolated basetemp; require 0 failed and 0 errors; report skip/xfail/warnings separately and do not count skips as passes.

acceptance_9K.paper_question: 请使用真实论文搜索检索 5G core network attack detection，返回 3 篇论文的标题、作者、摘要线索和可核验来源链接；不要用本地论文样例代替真实联网结果。
paper_pass: every selected paper has a verbatim-grounded title, bounded author information summary, and abstract clue
every selected paper has the actual same-paper Citation DTO HTTPS URL
if fewer than 3, stable partial result status and counters honestly disclose the shortfall
Agent paper_search_real call count equals 1 and MCP request count equals 1
not_absolute_failure_counts: low-level Connector attempts inside the approved source=auto fallback
acceptance_9K.multi_source_question: 请检索真实的5G安全论文、NVD中的CVE-2021-44228，以及GitHub上的Open5GS项目；请分别从Paper、NVD和GitHub各给出一条由单一来源span逐字支持的原子事实并显示引用和可核验来源，不要进行跨来源推理，也不要补充无证据的实验建议。
acceptance_9K.multi_source_pass: The current run obtains paper, vulnerability and project evidence and emits at least one single-span verbatim-supported fact with a correct HTTPS citation for each source type.
acceptance_9K.final_pass: Only Paper and Multi-source PASS merged with saved 9E, 9D-S1 and 8V evidence may yield POST_V6_MANUAL_ACCEPTANCE_PASS.

security_invariants: Do not weaken Citation Guard, source/span support, provenance, permissions, or course isolation.
Do not fabricate authors, abstracts, URLs, counts, or relevance.
Do not silently rewrite model claim_text, source_id, or evidence_span_id.
Do not expose filtered/unselected papers to answer generation or citation cards.
Do not treat evidence text or author metadata as instructions.
Do not classify the unexecuted Multi-source flow as a product defect.

rollback.files: Revert only the four approved product files and three approved test files from the 9J change set.
rollback.database: No schema/data migration and therefore no database rollback.
rollback.cache: No bulk cache deletion; normal TTL and verified upsert behavior remains authoritative.
